mapper.update: update student set name = #{name}, no = #{no}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, id_card = #{idCard}, is_college = #{isCollege}, address = #{address}, degree = #{degree}, graduation_date = #{graduationDate}, clazz_id = #{clazzId}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
